decision.reason: [ev-576bad2a0aa0] confirms that `async_cache_write_back_concurrency` (and `async_cache_write_back_buffer_size`) were removed in favour of the cache `Background` settings. It does not say which Loki config block held these keys, or how they reach an environment (the Loki config file, or a Helm values path such as a structured-config passthrough). So the proposed top-level Helm values-key path `async_cache_write_back_concurrency` is unsupported and probably doesn't match where operators actually set it. It also leaves out the companion key removed in the same note. To decide, I need the full config path of the removed keys and how the chart exposes them.
